text: May sixth, nineteen thirty-seven. The Hindenburg reaches Lakehurst, hours late.
asr: May 6, 1937. The Hindenburg reaches Lakehurst, hours late.

text: The station's answer: delay landing. The ship waits.
At six twenty-one, the ropes go down, at least seven hundred feet from the mast.
asr: At 621, the ropes go down, at least 700 feet from the mast.

text: Seconds before the fire, a man on the ground sees the cover flutter, near cell five.
asr: Seconds before the fire, a man on the ground sees the cover flutter, near cell 5.

text: Five sources, one place: above gas cells four and five.
asr: Five sources, one place, above gas cells 4 and 5.

text: From first flame to impact: thirty-two seconds.
asr: From first flame to impact, 32 seconds.

text: The inquiry names the cause: leaking hydrogen, ignited. The spark itself remains a theory.
